limitations: One newly collected ARM run; paired control reused from the earlier completed API-selector study. No run-level SD.
Task-bootstrap intervals measure task sampling, not website drift, judge error or differences in deployment/concurrency.
Invalid and unjudged outcomes count as zero. The canonical AgentTrek judge allows partial progress.
Latency comparison is descriptive across deployments. Allocation GPU-hours belong to the new ARM campaign only.
One recovered control record lacks browser-step timing; this missing value is excluded from that metric only and its outcome remains included.
Compute proxy is 2 × 4B parameters × generated actor/selector tokens; excludes prefill, attention, vision and caching. It is neither measured FLOPs nor dollars.
Token totals include every metered actor attempt; unmetered failures reported separately. Selector totals cover committed decision receipts.
FlashInfer ignores per-request seeds; server seed was verified, but deterministic paired trajectories are not claimed.
Saved terminal screenshots decoded and matched to verdict receipts; no independent human adjudication is claimed.
